question: addEventListener ke third parameter options object mein kya hota hai?
explanation: Options: { once: true } ek baar chale, { passive: true } preventDefault nahi kar sakta (scroll performance), { capture: true } capturing phase mein chale.

question: Event capturing vs bubbling mein kya farq hai?
options: Capturing: root se target tak, Bubbling: target se root tak
Dono same direction mein jaate hain
explanation: Capturing phase: event root se neeche jaata hai target tak. Bubbling phase: event target se upar jaata hai root tak. Default bubbling hota hai, capture ke liye { capture: true } lagao.

question: Dynamic elements (baad mein add huye) pe event lagane ka best tareeka?
options: Event delegation — parent pe listener lagao
Har naye element pe naya listener lagao
explanation: Delegation se parent pe ek listener lagao — naye elements bhi automatically handle honge bina naye listeners ke. Clean aur performant.

question: Memory leaks kyun hote hain events mein?
options: Remove nahi kiye gaye listeners rehte hain jab element delete hota hai
explanation: Agar element remove kar diya but uspe listener rehta hai toh memory leak hota hai. removeEventListener ya cleanup karo component hatane pe. WeakRef modern solution hai.

question: IntersectionObserver event-based approach se better kyun hai scroll tracking mein?
options: scroll event peh bahut zyada fire hota hai, Observer optimized hai
explanation: Scroll event continuously fire hota hai — scroll listener = performance hit. IntersectionObserver optimized hai browser-level pe, kam resources leta hai.
